name: Dólar (Spain)
description: Green field with a white saltire throughout charged with eight red roundels, two on each arm.
history: Dólar adopted its arms and flag officially on 1 September 1994; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, green, with a white saltire or cross of Saint Andrew from edge to edge bearing eight red circles, two on each arm.

features.role: saltire of Saint Andrew from edge to edge
two roundels on each arm of the saltire
